gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.

gaps.sentence: Parcels ___ (leave) in the porch if nobody is home.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: should be + left. A recommendation; 'are left' (routine) is also acceptable.

gaps.sentence: The temple is thought ___ (build) more than two thousand years ago.
gaps.explanation: Perfect passive infinitive: to have been + built for an event earlier than the main verb.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ (sell) within an hour of going on sale.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + sold. 'All the tickets' takes a plural verb.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't pay because her wallet ___ (steal) at the market.
gaps.hint: earlier past action causing a past problem
gaps.explanation: The theft happened before the failed payment: past perfect passive, had been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: The novel ___ (write) in under three months.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive (was/were + past participle): was written. The writer is not mentioned.

gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.

gaps.sentence: My usual barber's chair ___ (fix), so I'm trying a new salon.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: is being + fixed for an unfinished, ongoing repair.
